note: Suggestions only. Add your own in ~/.t3orq/tools.json; those are tried first.

tools.name: laya
tools.use: Run laya-code check|classify|score|rank --input <json-file> for a typed decision with a probability. Advisory only.

tools.name: jev
tools.use: Call the jev classify/check tool with raw evidence as state. Advisory only.

tools.name: hindsight
tools.use: Call recall once at intake and retain decisions and outcomes at integration.

tools.name: graphify
tools.use: Run graphify query before broad file reads.

tools.name: codegraph
tools.use: Run codegraph query or explore before broad file reads.

tools.name: semble
tools.use: Run semble search "<what the code does>" before broad file reads.

tools.name: gh
tools.use: Use gh for pull requests and checks.

tools.name: glab
tools.use: Use glab for merge requests and pipelines.
